claims_in_article.decontextualised_claim_text: FBI raids Georgia election office over 2020 voter fraud claims.
The FBI raided a Georgia election office on Wednesday as it examined allegations of voter fraud in the 2020 US election.
The 2020 election marked the first time since 1992 that a Democrat had won the southern US state of Georgia.

Trump faced two criminal indictments related to election interference in Georgia; a federal case that ended after Trump returned to the White House in 2025, and a Georgia state racketeering case that fell apart due to prosecutorial error.
